products.title: Trump Not Ready To Die screenprinted on white heavy duty (1-24) or soft light tee
products.body_html:
Not Ready to Die (2024)

Donald Trump, now known as "The Notorious DJT,"  has released his first mixtape since the assassination attempt, titled "Not Ready to Die." The title is a tribute to Notorious B.I.G.'s iconic 1994 album Ready to Die, coinciding with the 30th anniversary of its release. The mixtape’s tracks eerily mirror the original tracklist, with titles like "Who Shot Ya," "Machine Gun Funk," "Unbelievable," and "One More Chance," all alluding to the events of July 13th.

In this album, Trump channels the style of Christopher Wallace, the legendary Brooklyn MC better known as Notorious B.I.G. By making these connections, Trump not only pays homage to the iconic rapper but also weaves his own near-death experience into the fabric of hip-hop history, aligning his personal narrative with the legacy of one of the genre's most influential figures.

products.title: Brooklyn Cassettes Buttery Soft Tee
products.body_html:
A nod to analog culture & borough-born sound. Brooklyn Cassettes blends vintage music nostalgia with modern comfort; printed on an ultra-soft, lightweight tee that feels broken-in from the first wear. Designed for movement, layering, & all-day ease, this piece trades weight for flow without sacrificing presence.

Crafted from a laundered 60/40 ring-spun cotton/polyester sueded jersey, the fabric delivers a smooth, buttery hand-feel with a refined drape that wears effortlessly on its own or under a jacket. Soft to the touch, easy on the body, & built for everyday rotation.

Features-

  • 4.3 oz lightweight fabric for a soft, breathable feel
  • 60/40 ring-spun cotton / polyester sueded jersey
  • Laundered for a broken-in, vintage softness
  • Buttery smooth hand-feel with a clean, flattering drape
  • Soft yet durable for everyday wear
  • Classic fit; easy to layer, easy to live in
  • Designed on subway platforms & an illegal Bushwick basement; printed with care

Rendered as a cross-section that feels part blueprint, part birthday cake, the design captures New York as both machine and celebration.

 

Printed in a detailed single-color line style, the artwork carries architectural weight with a hand-drawn pulse. Set against a clean white tee, the illustration reads crisp and dimensional, allowing every line and layer to breathe.

 

Printed on an ultra-soft, lightweight white tee, this version trades heaviness for flow. The laundered 60/40 ring-spun cotton/polyester sueded jersey delivers a buttery hand-feel with a smooth drape that wears effortlessly from the first day.

products.title: New York City Arteries Buttery Soft Tees
products.body_html:
Royal blue & black suede tees

New York Arteries reimagines the city as a living body; its boroughs mapped like an anatomical heart, its subway lines & streets flowing like veins & capillaries. Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, & the Bronx are charted as vital organs, pulsing together in a system powered by movement, pressure, & persistence.

Rendered in intricate single-color linework, the illustration blends medical diagram, transit map, & hand-drawn mythology. Printed in crisp contrast on a deep royal blue tee, the design feels electric; technical yet organic, precise yet alive.

This version is printed on an ultra-soft, lightweight tee that trades weight for flow. The laundered 60/40 ring-spun cotton/polyester sueded jersey delivers a buttery hand-feel with a smooth drape that wears effortlessly from day one.

  • 60/40 ring-spun cotton / polyester sueded jersey
  • Laundered for a broken-in, buttery-soft feel
  • Royal blue base for bold contrast & line detail
  • Intricate single-color anatomical / cartographic artwork
  • Soft yet durable; built for everyday rotation

products.title: A-Bombshell 1/1 Premium Heavyweight Ladies’  Tee
products.body_html:
a true 1/1 never to be duplicated, one of PJ’s favorites in the catalog.

Chaotic, cinematic, & singular. A-Bombshell fuses mid-century glamour with atomic anxiety; an icon caught between spotlight & fallout. The familiar silhouette evokes 1950s cinema & flashing cameras, but here elegance fractures. A mushroom cloud erupts where a head should be, surrounded by concentric rings that suggest orbit, explosion, spectacle, & myth collapsing in on itself.

Printed in metallic silver ink, the linework shimmers against a deep black field; fluid, electric, & alive with motion. The figures repeat & stutter across the surface, creating a sense of instability & excess, as if fame itself is looping, multiplying, & detonating in real time. Sneakers anchor the imagery in the present, bridging postwar symbolism with modern street language.

This version is printed on an ultra-soft, lightweight tee with a buttery hand-feel & smooth drape. The laundered 60/40 ring-spun cotton/polyester sueded jersey wears effortlessly from day one, allowing the chaos of the artwork to contrast against a calm, luxurious touch.

A literal blonde bombshell; glamour weaponized, beauty irradiated, legend frozen at the moment of impact.

Features-

  • One-of-one release
  • 6 oz./yd² (US), 10 oz./L yd (CA), 100% Airlume combed & ring-spun cotton, 20 singles
  • Mid-length, boxy fit
  • Set-in sleeves
  • Double stitched neck
  • Side seams
